name: Tadasana
description: A foundational standing pose that improves posture and body awareness.

slouching.english: Stand tall, roll your shoulders back.
slouching.marathi: सरळ उभे राहा, तुमचे खांदे मागे घ्या.

name: Adho Mukha Svanasana
description: An inversion that stretches the entire back body and builds upper body strength.

shoulders_forward.english: Push your hips back and up.
shoulders_forward.marathi: तुमचे नितंब मागे आणि वर ढकला.

knees_bent.english: Gently straighten your legs if comfortable.
knees_bent.marathi: जर शक्य असेल तर पाय हळूवारपणे सरळ करा.

name: Vrikshasana
description: A balancing pose that improves focus and strengthens the legs and core.

wobbling.english: Find a focal point in front of you.
wobbling.marathi: समोरच्या एका बिंदूवर लक्ष केंद्रित करा.

name: Virabhadrasana I
description: A deep lunge that stretches the hip flexors and strengthens the legs and back.

front_knee_past_ankle.english: Ensure your front knee is directly over your ankle.
front_knee_past_ankle.marathi: तुमचा पुढचा गुडघा घोट्याच्या सरळ रेषेत असावा.

name: Virabhadrasana II
description: A standing pose that builds stamina and stretches the hips and groin.

knee_collapsing_in.english: Keep your front knee pointing straight ahead.
knee_collapsing_in.marathi: तुमचा पुढचा गुडघा सरळ पुढे ठेवा.

name: Trikonasana
description: A standing side stretch that opens the chest and stretches the hamstrings.

chest_facing_floor.english: Open your chest towards the side.

name: Bhujangasana
description: A gentle backbend that strengthens the spine and opens the chest.

shoulders_by_ears.english: Relax your shoulders away from your ears.
shoulders_by_ears.marathi: तुमचे खांदे कानांपासून दूर आणि सैल ठेवा.

name: Balasana
description: A resting pose that gently stretches the hips, thighs, and ankles.

hips_high.english: Sink your hips back towards your heels.

name: Paschimottanasana
description: A calming forward bend that stretches the hamstrings and lower back.

rounding_back.english: Keep your back straight and fold from the hips.
rounding_back.marathi: तुमची पाठ सरळ ठेवा आणि नितंबातून पुढे वाका.

name: Uttanasana
description: An intense forward stretch that calms the brain and stretches the hamstrings.

locked_knees.english: Keep a micro-bend in your knees.

name: Cat-Cow
description: A gentle warm-up flow that mobilizes the spine and relieves back tension.

neck_strain.english: Keep your neck in line with your spine.

name: Setu Bandhasana
description: A backbend that strengthens the glutes, hamstrings, and lower back.

hips_low.english: Lift your hips higher towards the ceiling.

name: Utkatasana
description: A powerful standing pose that strengthens the thighs and ankles.

knees_past_toes.english: Sit back as if into a chair, keep knees behind toes.
knees_past_toes.marathi: खुर्चीत बसल्यासारखे मागे बसा, गुडघे बोटांच्या मागे ठेवा.

name: Navasana
description: A core-strengthening pose that also improves balance and digestion.

back_rounding.english: Lengthen your spine and lift your chest.
back_rounding.marathi: तुमचा मणका लांब करा आणि छाती वर उचला.

name: Phalakasana
description: A full-body strengthening pose that builds core stability.

hips_sagging.english: Engage your core and keep your body in a straight line.
hips_sagging.marathi: तुमचा कोर सक्रिय करा आणि शरीर सरळ रेषेत ठेवा.

name: Garudasana
description: A balancing pose that stretches the shoulders and hips while improving focus.

arms_uneven.english: Wrap your arms and lift your elbows to shoulder height.
arms_uneven.marathi: हात गुंडाळा आणि कोपरे खांद्याच्या उंचीवर उचला.

name: Natarajasana
description: A graceful balancing backbend that opens the chest and strengthens the legs.

wobbling.english: Fix your gaze on a still point and engage your core.
wobbling.marathi: एका स्थिर बिंदूवर नजर ठेवा आणि कोर सक्रिय करा.

name: Ardha Chandrasana
description: A challenging balance pose that strengthens the legs and opens the hips.

hip_dropping.english: Stack your hips and open your chest to the side.
hip_dropping.marathi: नितंब एकावर एक ठेवा आणि छाती बाजूला उघडा.

name: Ustrasana
description: A deep backbend that opens the chest and stretches the hip flexors.

neck_strain.english: Keep your neck neutral or look straight up, not back.
neck_strain.marathi: मान तटस्थ ठेवा किंवा सरळ वर पहा.

name: Baddha Konasana
description: A seated hip opener that stretches the inner thighs and groin.

knees_high.english: Gently press your knees towards the floor.

name: Savasana
description: A final relaxation pose that allows the body to absorb the benefits of practice.

name: Viparita Karani
description: A restorative inversion that relieves tired legs and calms the nervous system.

name: Anjaneyasana
description: A hip-opening lunge that stretches the hip flexors and quadriceps.

front_knee_past_ankle.english: Keep your front knee directly above your ankle.
front_knee_past_ankle.marathi: पुढचा गुडघा घोट्याच्या सरळ वर ठेवा.

name: Parsvakonasana
description: A standing pose that stretches the side body and strengthens the legs.

chest_facing_floor.english: Rotate your chest open towards the ceiling.

name: Prasarita Padottanasana
description: A standing forward fold that stretches the hamstrings and inner thighs.

rounding_back.english: Lengthen your spine as you fold forward.

name: Sukhasana
description: A comfortable cross-legged seated pose for breathing and meditation.

name: Gomukhasana
description: A seated pose that deeply stretches the hips, thighs, and shoulders.

leaning_forward.english: Sit upright and keep your spine tall.
leaning_forward.marathi: सरळ बसा आणि मणका उंच ठेवा.

name: Supta Matsyendrasana
description: A gentle lying twist that releases tension in the spine and hips.

shoulder_lifting.english: Keep both shoulders grounded on the mat.

name: Virabhadrasana III
description: A challenging balance pose that strengthens the entire posterior chain.

hip_rotation.english: Keep both hips level and square to the floor.

name: Dhanurasana
description: A prone backbend that opens the chest and strengthens the back muscles.

name: Shalabhasana
description: A prone backbend that strengthens the back, glutes, and legs.

neck_strain.english: Keep your gaze down and neck long.
neck_strain.marathi: नजर खाली ठेवा आणि मान लांब ठेवा.

name: Ananda Balasana
description: A gentle hip opener that releases the lower back and inner groin.

lower_back_lifting.english: Press your lower back gently into the mat.
lower_back_lifting.marathi: पाठीचा खालचा भाग हळूवारपणे चटईवर दाबा.
